name: kirothon
description: KIROTHON 2026 — AAcrew. 실행 명령은 모두 여기서 시작한다.

scripts.bootstrap: uv sync --extra dev && pnpm -C frontend install
scripts.bootstrap:deliverables: npm --prefix deliverables install && npm --prefix deliverables run setup
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "pnpm run dev:api" "pnpm run dev:web"
scripts.smoke:ui: pnpm run build && uv run python scripts/smoke.py --ui
scripts.check: pnpm run check:py && pnpm run check:web
scripts.check:py: uv run ruff check . && uv run pytest
scripts.check:web: pnpm -C frontend exec tsc -b && pnpm -C frontend test && pnpm -C frontend lint
